An unidentified [[Gender|male]] '''trader''' was present in a [[Cantina/Legends|bar]] on [[Lazerian IV]], after catching a glimpse of an [[Akwin]] near [[Laz]]. Having snapped a blurry, unconvincing [[Hologram/Legends|holoimage]] of the Akwin, he began to tell other travelers about the supposed [[Ocean/Legends|sea]] creature, though most did not believe him.<ref name="TSoK" />

{{RPGseed}}
However, a group of travelers did take interest in what the trader was saying, and learned of the discovery's location after buying the trader some drinks. An [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] marine biologist also took interest, and went to investigate. After leaving the bar, the trader was attacked by six hooded Akwin, who stole the holoimage from him without injuring him.<ref name="TSoK" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
The unidentified trader was created by [[John Terra]] and introduced in [[Twin Stars of Kira (sourcebook)|''Twin Stars of Kira'']], a [[1993]] supplement to [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="TSoK" />
